cards.title: Glossary
items: Strike pass: each candidate criterion kept, struck or reworded by the seats before any check is written
r2: the request's second revision row, the struck criteria signed by the PO seat
OPEN: a question the request cannot close alone; a seat rules it under Decisions
Cursor: the one node in flight; the pane keeps its path open
ADR 0024: the unit graph, and the home of execution state at .sdlc/progress/<id>.yaml
ADR 0027: no committed plan; the unit graph derives from the contract
ADR 0029: the feature document format; no tooling reads a document's headings
herdr: the terminal multiplexer the pilot runs sessions in; version 0.9.1 takes plugins
Later cut: a criterion moved out of the first build because it needs a request not yet built
